messages:
sec-bot: [ALERT] High egress volume detected from subnet subnet-08f... in prod-eu-west-1. Route table rtb-0a1b2c3 has 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0d4e5f. Potential exfil pattern. INC-4982 created.

maria (sec-eng): Heads up — sec-bot flagged an unexpected default route in prod. Traffic spike from instances with instance profile prod-data-processor. Suspect misconfig/change. :eyes:

samir (oncall): Oncall here, grabbing context. Which AZ/subnet exactly? Any recent deploys or infra changes? Link to runbook?

maria (sec-eng): Route table attached to subnet subnet-08f4, AZ eu-west-1b. CloudTrail hint: CreateRoute/ReplaceRoute events around 2026-02-14T14:08Z. Snippet:

```
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --route-table-ids rtb-0a1b2c3
"Routes": [ {"DestinationCidrBlock": "0.0.0.0/0", "GatewayId": null, "NatGatewayId": "nat-0d4e5f" }, ... ]
```

Also listing instances: `aws ec2 describe-instances --filters Name=iam-instance-profile.arn,Values=*prod-data-processor*` shows i-0aa111, i-0bb222 heavy outbound.

jordan (sre-lead): Check CloudTrail for ReplaceRoute/CreateRoute and who assumed an infra role. Also enumerate which maint runbooks could have touched RTs. If NAT was swapped as part of maint, maybe route table got reattached incorrectly. Enable VPC flow logs for that subnet now.

anna (prod-support): I see multiple external connections from i-0aa111 to 52.x.x.x on port 443 and repeated PUTs to s3://temp-ingest-prod. Pausing the prod-data-processor autoscaling group now.

samir (oncall): Taking containment actions: 1) Removing 0.0.0.0/0 route from rtb-0a1b2c3, 2) detaching nat-0d4e5f from that subnet, 3) pausing ASG. Applying now.

samir (oncall): Done — route removed at 2026-02-14T14:22Z. ASG paused. Confirming dropped outbound in CloudWatch — graphs show immediate drop. :white_check_mark:

maria (sec-eng): Good. Next: lock down the IAM instance profile. prod-data-processor role currently allows s3:* and iam:PassRole. Propose immediate inline policy to remove iam:PassRole and restrict S3 to GetObject/List only, then force creds refresh via instance restart or replace. Will run change with approval.

jordan (sre-lead): Also enable CloudTrail data events for that S3 bucket and enable S3 object-level logging. Push VPC Flow Logs to the SIEM stream and tag events. Add an alarm for any new default-route on route tables in prod accounts.

anna (prod-support): Investigated S3 PUTs — 3 objects under temp-ingest-prod/2026-02-14/ look like compressed logs, size ~2.4MB each. KMS decrypt logs show uses by prod-data-processor role only. Nothing indicates public exposure. No external S3 GETs.

maria (sec-eng): Triage summary: attack vector looked like an accidental/misconfigured route change that allowed broad egress from data-processing fleet. Containment: route removed, ASG paused, IAM role restricted. No confirmed exfil of sensitive S3 buckets. Notifying privacy and product-security. :lock:

samir (oncall): Created short incident doc: https://notes.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-4982 (contains timeline, actions, artifacts). Paging legal/privacy for review of the 3 PUT objects.

jordan (sre-lead): Post-incident actions (initial): 1) Add IaC pre-commit guard: block route creations with 0.0.0.0/0 in prod TF plans. 2) Add route-table-change CloudWatch Event -> SNS -> PagerDuty. 3) Require manual approval for any NAT/route modifications in prod. 4) Add unit/integration test for NAT replacement automation. Assigned eng-infra.

maria (sec-eng): Add-on actions: 1) Audit roles for permissive iam:PassRole & s3:* in prod; revoke where not needed. 2) Enable more granular CloudTrail data event capture for S3 and KMS. 3) Schedule KMS key usage review and rotate CMKs for ingest buckets if privacy requests it. Owner: maria. ETA 72h.

ops-bot: JIRA SEC-7012 created and linked to INC-4982.

anna (prod-support): Confirming no new outbound after containment, re-enabled some read-only consumers. Will keep ASG paused for 2 hours for additional checks. :thumbsup:

maria (sec-eng): Thanks team. Postmortem to include timeline, root cause (manual NAT swap + missing guardrail), remediation as above, and a follow-up verification run in staging. Will run tabletop with oncall and infra next week. :calendar:
